column1: # Rows db.t5d.* (line RG item T5d; tests/db_search/t5/make_t5.py --header-only): the version 4 databases phd_<name> and nhd_<name> of three records (hd.faa, hd.fna; queries hd_q.*, query n hitting record n) whose header record of OID 1 (of OID 0 for title_z, which the query hd_q1.* of record 1 never reports) NCBI's read fails on: a taxid tag (vstr), data where the taxid's end is expected (extra), the taxid's tag primitive (prim), 2^31 as the taxid (big5), the title's tag (title), the record cut before its last four bytes (cut), the first string of the Seq-ids with -parse_seqids (seqid). NCBI reports its CSerialException (Error: what(), exit 255) after the outfmt 0 prolog and the reports of the batches before (BATCH_SIZE=1 rows); a record that no report reads fails nothing (title_z, exit 0). Rows that NCBI reads (T5d fix 1): the title of OID 1 a UTF8String (utf8; utf8_z at OID 0), with -parse_seqids the local id's string a UTF8String (utf8id), both read as the VisibleString with NCBI's warning `Warning: (803.10) [<program>] CObjectIStreamAsnBinary: UTF8String data for VisibleString member Blast-def-line-set.E.title, ASN.1 specification may need an update` once per process, where the Seq-aligns of a batch first read such a record; the title's member tag in the long form (long), read with no message; a member tag in the long form of no member (longx) fails as any other unexpected member. The record of OID 1 cut after its first byte (eof): NCBI's CEofException, which the programs' CATCH_ALL takes as a CIOException without a post: exit 0 after the reports before.

# Rows db.t5d.*.fx* (line RG item T5d fix 2; tests/db_search/t5/make_t5.py --fetch-only): the version 5 databases pfx_utf8, pfx_utf8r, nfx_utf8, pfx_copy and nfx_copy (-parse_seqids; a strong match of the query hd_q0.*, a weak one with a UTF8String title, another sequence) under a negative seqid list with ids (fx_neg*.txt and the others): NCBI's traceback and composition-based redo read the header of each subject they fetch (the redo only those its early termination test leaves, BlastCompo_EarlyTermination; blastx's redo by subject, the others' by E-value), so a UTF8String sequence that no report shows writes NCBI's warning there, or not; the ungapped re-evaluation of tblastx and blastn -ungapped fetches every subject with HSPs.

# Rows db.t5d.*.dup* (line RG item T5d fix 3; tests/db_search/t5/make_t5.py --dup-only): database lists that hold gb|DUP00001.1| twice (pdo_same or pdo_none at OID 0, the subject pds at OID 1; pda pdo_none the subject first): NCBI's data loader reads the header of the sequence that the lookup of a Seq-align id gives first (x_GetOid), with the warning of its UTF8String title, wherever its scope resolves the id (the prefetch and the formats that read the Bioseq), and no other holder.

# Rows db.t5d.*.dup5* (line RG item T5d fix 5; tests/db_search/t5/make_t5.py --dup5-only): lists that hold gb|DUP00005.1| twice (the copy pdo5_same or ndo5_same with its title a UTF8String first) beside gnl|PIG|x001 (ppig1, npig1; packed 1, so NCBI's prefetch loads it first, and its lookup throws: Error pre-fetching sequence data) or gnl|PIG|x005 (ppig5, one packed number with DUP00005's), beside gb|DUQ00005.1| twice (pdo5b_same: title, pdo5b_id: accession a UTF8String), or with gi|5 twice and a database without the accession table (pplain: the prefetch stops); queries hd_q10.* (q1, q0, q0b) and hd_q02.* (q0, q2). The losat-rejection rows: an order that NCBI takes from the addresses of its Seq-id infos, and a report that reads the subject whose lookup throws (line DBID's refusal).

# Rows db.t5d.*.m4.* (line RG item T5d merge 4, 2026-11-18): T5d's UTF8String title (803.10) beside line DBID's lookup that throws (`DB contains no accession info.`) in outfmt 15 and 16: the list `.b.` puts a database without the accession table (pplain, multidb/nnp) before the one that holds gb|DUP00005.1| (the copy ndo5_same/pdo5_same with its title a UTF8String first, then nds5/pds5), so that the lookup of the reported id throws; `.c.` the control: the list without that database (the lookup finds the copy first, nothing throws). A database without the table anywhere in a version 5 list makes the lookup of every reported parsed Seq-id throw (the version check reads the UTF8String header first, so NCBI's warning comes before the failure). `.lim0.` PRE_FETCH_SEQS_LIMIT=0 turns the prefetch off, the Seq-aligns of the report read the subject one by one: NCBI's lookup reads the UTF8String header first (its warning, once) and then throws (outfmt 15 and 16 catch it: `Error: [<program>] ` and the exception's text, exit 0); `.dflt.` the prefetch on: the warning, then the batch's prefetch stops the run (`BLAST Database error: DB contains no accession info.`, exit 2). Query hd_q0 (the record of gb|DUP00005.1|).

# Rows db.t5d.blastp.sw* (line RG item T5d merge 6, 2026-11-21; tests/db_search/t5/make_t5.py --sw-only): T5d's UTF8String title (803.10) beside line RG item X4's failed Smith-Waterman redo (rows db.x4excl.first.*): psw_utf8 (sfail's title a UTF8String) and psw_utf8x (sx_strong's) under tests/db_search/x4excl/neg.txt with tks_W: NCBI's redo fetches sx_strong (excluded) and sfail and reads both headers before sfail's redo fails the batch (BLAST engine error: Traceback failed, exit status 3), so its warning comes before its error, after the outfmt 0 prolog. Freeze them alone with db_search_fixtures.py freeze --ncbi-bin DIR --program blastp --only db.t5d.blastp.sw.
